lines.h1: Finch or Habitica? Here's the answer in ten seconds.
lines.h2: Want gentle self-care, with no penalty for a bad day? Finch.
lines.h3: Want your habits and to-dos to play like a game, with real stakes? Habitica.
lines.h4: Now, five rounds to prove it. Plus one bonus round, where a third app comes in.
lines.r1a: Round one. When you miss a day.
lines.r1b: In Habitica, every Daily you skip costs your character health. Hit zero, and you lose a level, your gold and a piece of gear.
lines.r1c: In Finch, a missed day costs nothing. You set the next goal, and your bird keeps going.
lines.r1d: If one bad day usually makes you quit an app, round to Finch.
lines.r2b: Habitica gives you a real system. Habits, Dailies on a schedule, and a to-do list.
lines.r2c: Finch tracks small self-care goals. It's not a task manager.
lines.r3b: Finch has a mood tracker, journaling, breathing exercises and morning and evening check-ins.
lines.r3c: Habitica doesn't try. It cares about what you did, not how you felt.
lines.r4a: Round four. Rewards that keep you coming back.
lines.r4b: Habitica pays you in gold, gear and pets, and you can set your own real-life rewards.
lines.r4c: Finch grows your bird and sends it on adventures every time you finish a goal.
lines.r4d: Both are genuinely fun. This one's a tie.
lines.r5b: Habitica has parties, shared challenges and guilds. Your missed Dailies can even hurt your party in a boss fight.
lines.r5c: Finch has goal buddies, so a friend can cheer you on.
lines.r5d: If you need people counting on you, round to Habitica.
lines.sc: Two rounds each, and a tie. So don't pick the better app. Pick the one built for your problem.
lines.b1: One more round. The one big task you've been avoiding for a week.
lines.b2: Both apps reward you after you act. Neither helps much with the moment before you start.
lines.f1: Full disclosure, that's the gap we built FOCO for. It starts from the task you're putting off.
lines.f2: It breaks the task into tiny steps, each with a time estimate.
lines.f3: Then step one opens into a focus session, with a timer and a companion working next to you.
lines.o1: So. Finch for gentle self-care with no penalty. Habitica for habits that play like a game.
lines.o2: And FOCO for the big task you can't begin. Tell me in the comments which one you are.
